title: Twelve years of distributed SQLite
why_read: A detailed retrospective on long-running distributed SQLite systems is rare, practical, and technically meaty content for engineers building replicated data systems.
analysis: This appears to be a long-form retrospective on building and operating distributed SQLite systems over twelve years, likely covering replication strategies, consistency tradeoffs, and lessons learned from real production use. SQLite's single-writer, embedded nature makes distributing it nontrivial, so war stories here carry genuine engineering value. Content like this is valuable because it's grounded in sustained real-world experience rather than a one-off proof of concept.
